title: Mixer
_comment: The mixer's controls (studio/studio.c). A channel (an engine's stem) has LEVEL..SOLO, FILTER..RESONANCE (Surge's filters, studio/filter.cpp) and DUCK..DUCK_RELEASE (sidechain ducking); a send bus has FX and RETURN; the master has LEVEL. Faders: 100 is 0 dB, gain = (value / 100)^3.

params.name: Level
params.help: How loud it is in the mix. 0 dB leaves it as the instrument makes it.

params.name: Pan
params.help: Where it sits between the speakers: L, center, R.

params.name: Send A
params.help: How much of it goes to effect A (a reverb at first).

params.name: Send B
params.help: How much of it goes to effect B (a delay at first).

params.name: Solo
params.help: Plays only the soloed channels (and the effects they send to).

params.name: Effect
params.help: The effect on this send: hall and room reverbs, a tempo delay, chorus, phaser, flanger.

params.name: Return
params.help: How loud the effect comes back into the mix.

params.name: Filter
params.help: Surge's filters on the channel: low-pass, ladders, high-pass, band-pass, notch.

params.name: Cutoff
params.help: The filter's frequency. Sweep it for the build-ups and breakdowns.

params.name: Resonance
params.help: How much the filter rings at its cutoff; the ladders whistle at the top.

params.name: Duck
params.help: How far it dips each time its key hits (the kick, at first): the pump of trance.

params.name: Duck key
params.help: The channel that makes this one dip. It works muted too: a silent kick can pump a pad.

params.name: Duck release
params.help: How fast the channel comes back after a dip: short is a tight pump, long a slow swell.
